sentences.text: BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA  ON THE 7 th OF FEBRUARY, 2025  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 1096 of 2025  MANOHARSINGH AND OTHERS  Versus  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH AND OTHERS  Appearance:
Shri Himanshu Thakur, Advocate for the applicants.

Ms. Shraddha Dixit, Panel Lawyer for the non-applicant/
 Shri Vijay Sharma, Advocate for the objector/complainan  ORDER

After arguing for a while, learned counsel for the applicants seeks leave of this Court to withdraw present anticipatory bail application filed by the applicants u/s 438 of Cr.P.C./482 of BNSS, who are apprehending arrest in connection with FIR/Crime No.448/2023 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station Dindayal Nagar, District Ratlam for commission of offence punishable u/S 363,
366, 376(2)(n), 376-D, 342, 344 and 34 of IPC alongwith 5(l)/6 of the POCSO Act with liberty to surrender before the Trial Court/Competent Court.
With the aforesaid liberty, present anticipatory bail application is dismissed as withdrawn.

(PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA) JUDGE gp NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:3179 2 MCRC-1096-2025 Manoharsingh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44566172/
